notes: Printed names: WARNER (written 'Warner Street' as instructed), RAVINE ('Ravine Street' as on 227), EMMING west of Quarry ('Emming' as on 236/237), EMMING ST. east of Ravine ('Emming Street'), CONROY west of Quarry and CONROY ST. east of Ravine (both 'Conroy Street' as on 236), KLOTTER AV., BAYMILLER, QUARRY ST. Quarry Street is only a ~4 ft gap between blocks (x~4374-4400) running from the 20' '?' street (sheet 237/236's unnamed 20' street, south line only) down across Klotter (continues south as the 227 passage, so Quarry/Klotter is a cross as on 227). The '?' / Quarry T is on the assumed 20' centreline (65 px north of the drawn south line). Emming (west part) and Conroy (west part) both end at Quarry: the block between Quarry and Ravine (x 4400-4920) is continuous from the 20' street to Klotter. East of Ravine, Emming St. (y~4771) and Conroy St. (y~6228) are separate streets offset from the west parts (Emming ~180 px north, Conroy ~200 px south); they end at Ravine (T) and run off east onto 239/228. Do NOT join Quarry/Conroy to Ravine/Conroy or Quarry/Emming to Ravine/Emming Street: there is no street across that block. Baymiller (50') starts at Conroy (Conroy's north line continuous, T) and crosses Klotter onto 227. Klotter ends at Ravine (T, as on 227). Ravine crosses Warner and runs north onto 250. The single lines at y~1250 and y~2450 across the hillside are lot lines, not streets. Stairs along Baymiller's east side are not recorded.
